title: Thread and fit a loose necktie
instruction: Finish the pre-wrapped necktie: pass the wide blade down through the front loop, snug the knot, slide it up using the narrow blade, and leave both blades neat with hands clear. The collar is a rigid practice form, not a person.
context: Adjusting a necktie is a familiar dressing skill and a useful form of assistance for someone with limited hand movement.
setup: A reversible woven polyester tie, 1.26 m long, 70 mm wide at the wide end, 35 mm at the narrow end and about 1.2 mm thick, is pre-wrapped for a loose Simple knot on a rigid plastic collar form. The wide end has been brought up through the neck opening but hangs outside the front loop; it has not been threaded down through it. The loose wrap is 74 × 57 mm, centred 25 mm left of the collar mark, with its top 81.5 mm below the collar. Both hands start open. README and the diagram give the threading order and reset dimensions.
scoring: Judge after both hands release for 5 seconds. Award 0.5 if the intact threaded knot is at most 70 mm wide and high, with its top within 60 mm below the collar edge. Full credit also requires its top within 20 mm, its centre within 20 mm of the collar mark, the wide blade flat within 30 degrees of untwisted, its tip 350–440 mm below the collar edge, and the narrow blade behind it, within 15 mm laterally and with its tip at least 10 mm higher. Otherwise 0. Pulled-out ends, damaged fabric or added support score 0. Use front/rear photos, video and a ruler.
fidelity: A gravity-driven ribbon centreline models the unthreaded wide blade against an open sleeve. Actual tip passage through its top and bottom is required before a reduced sliding model snugs/fits the wrap. Finite pad grasps can slip; approximate 3 N feed resistance loads the native arms. Material length is conserved across the transition. Fine folds, arbitrary knot topology and full textile contact are omitted; parameters and numerical stretch limits are uncalibrated.
scores: Scripted demo: 1.0 in 1,150 steps (57.5 seconds). Dream-1: 0.0 in 1,800 steps (90 seconds).
reset_notes: Prepare only the first three Simple-knot steps in the diagram: wide behind narrow, across its front, then up through the neck opening. Leave the wide end outside the front loop, never tucked down through it. Set the stated wrap/collar offsets and let the loose end settle. Both ends must be free of clips, tape and keeper loops. Use the same tie and ruler-checked reset each trial; replace damaged fabric.
